entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Minion created by Lord Ith during the Dark Age, with a soul-taking touch.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Mage imprisoned by Mairsil, who summoned a Rag Man.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Apprentice who imprisoned Ith and died in his rampage.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Freed Ith and brought him to his senses.

entities.name: Barl
entities.description: Artificer who devised Ith's cage and became his new Rag Man.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Group that fell during Ith's rampage.

events.summary: Imprisoned by Mairsil, Ith summons a Rag Man who leads Jodah to the Conclave.
events.quote: Lord Ith, imprisoned by his apprentice Mairsil , summoned a Rag Man

events.summary: Jodah frees Ith, who rampages, killing Mairsil and the Rag Man; the Conclave falls.
events.quote: go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man

events.summary: Jodah brings Ith to his senses; Barl becomes Ith's new Rag Man.
events.quote: was turned into Ith's new Rag Man

relations.quote: The Rag Man or Ragman was a minion created by Lord Ith
